destination.name: Magnetic Island
destination.tagline: A national park island half an hour by ferry from Townsville, ringed by bays
destination.description: Magnetic Island lies 8 km off Townsville and takes about half an hour to reach by ferry. More than half of its roughly 7 km by 5 km area is national park, with about 25 km of walking tracks. Four small villages run up the east coast, from Picnic Bay to Horseshoe Bay, and the island's many bays range from patrolled family beaches to quiet coves with coral close to shore.
whyVisit: Swim and paddle in calm bays
Walk the island's national park tracks

goodToKnow.title: Ferry from Townsville
goodToKnow.detail: The island is reached only by boat, about 30 minutes from South Townsville to Nelly Bay. Cars can be carried, and buses link the bays.

goodToKnow.title: Stinger net in summer
goodToKnow.detail: A stinger net operates at Horseshoe Bay in summer, so swim inside it.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: {months} are the drier months, a good time for the bays and walking tracks.
